raw_discovery_candidates.name: Taker-rebate tier economics (volume tier as a cost edge)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Since 2026-05-28 heavy takers get 3-50% of their fees back; design taker strategies and flow aggregation around reaching Gold/Platinum+ tiers.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Weighted volume wV = trade size x (1 - entry price) x category weight (crypto 2.3, economics/culture/weather 1.7, politics/finance/mentions/tech 1.3, sports 1.0) over a trailing 30 days sets the tier: $200k -> 18%, $1M -> 32%, $4M -> 44%, $10M+ -> 50%, plus one-off level-up bonuses up to $25k. A taker strategy that is marginal at full fee can be viable at half fee, so consolidating all taker flow of a bot suite in one account matters. Note the arithmetic: self-trading to climb tiers is negative-sum on fees alone (taker gets <=50% back, maker pool returns 15-25% pro-rata), so wash volume only 'pays' if an external incentive (airdrop, LR) is assumed. No practitioner write-up of tier optimisation was found yet.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Non-linear fee schedule favouring scale; formula rewards buying low-priced shares in high-weight categories.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Small bots compete at full fee against Obsidian-tier takers paying half - the reader's suite should treat tier as a shared resource.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Programme terms can change; omnibus wallets ineligible; rebates not retroactive; chasing volume degrades selection.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Compute your suite's trailing wV and marginal rebate; re-run each taker strategy's backtest at 0/18/32/50% fee rebate to see which become viable.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Wash trading to reach tiers would be manipulation on a regulated venue and a ToS breach.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Fee-tier engineering: Taker Rebate tiers, level-up bonuses and referral rewards
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Structure volume so that taker strategies run at up to 50% lower fees, and collect tier bonuses and referral fee share.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Since 2026-05-28 takers earn daily rebates by 30-day weighted volume: Bronze $2k (3%) up to Obsidian $10M+ (50%), with one-time level-up bonuses of $10 to $25,000. Weighted volume = size x (1 - entry price) x category weight (crypto 2.3, economics/culture/weather 1.7, politics/finance/mentions/tech 1.3, sports 1.0, geopolitics 0), so low-priced crypto trades count most and 99c trades count almost nothing. Referrers earn 10% (direct) and 5% (indirect) of the referee's net fees for 30 days or until Platinum, after the referrer has $10k lifetime volume. For a latency or arb taker the tier decides viability: crypto fee 0.07 becomes an effective 0.035 at Obsidian.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Programme design: fee drag differs by up to 2x between accounts running the same strategy; concentration of all taker flow in one account beats splitting across agents.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Most small bot operators split strategies across wallets and sit at 0-3% rebate; consolidating taker flow, or routing it to reach the next tier before a high-volume event, is pure margin.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Volume chased for tiers is negative-EV if the underlying trades are not; programme terms change at Polymarket's discretion; self-referral and linked-account farming are explicitly clawed back.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Spreadsheet: for each planned taker agent, monthly weighted volume and fee paid; compute rebate at consolidated vs split accounts.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Wash trading, self-matching, self-referral or linked accounts to climb tiers violate ToS (explicit clawback language).

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Taker-fee tier consolidation (Taker Rebate Program)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Pool all taker flow of the agent suite into one directly-owned account to climb the 30-day Weighted-Volume tiers (3% to 50% of taker fees back, plus one-time level-up bonuses up to $25,000).
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Live since 2026-05-28. Weighted Volume = trade size x (1 - entry price) x category weight x bonuses, taker trades only; weights: sports 1.0, politics/finance/mentions/tech 1.3, economics/culture/weather/other 1.7, crypto 2.3, geopolitics 0. Tiers on a rolling 30 days, updated daily at midnight UTC: Bronze $2k wV 3%, Silver $20k 8%, Gold $200k 18%, Platinum $1M 32%, Diamond $4M 44%, Obsidian $10M 50%; level-up bonuses $10/$50/$250/$1,500/$7,500/$25,000 paid once. Because the fee is size x feeRate x (1-p) in notional terms, wV per fee dollar is simply weight/feeRate: about 33 in crypto, 20 in sports, 32.5 in politics, 34 in economics/culture/weather, so Gold needs roughly $6k-$10k of fees per 30 days and Obsidian roughly $300k-$500k. Rebates apply only to trades made after reaching the tier and are paid daily in pUSD.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Venue-granted scale economy: the same taker strategy has a materially lower break-even inside a high-tier account, so several small agents sharing one account beat the same agents run separately.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: News/latency and arb agents in crypto pay up to 1.75c per share at 50c; Gold cuts that by 18% and Platinum by 32%, which flips marginal signals positive; most small bots sit at tier 0.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Negative finding worth stating: level-up bonuses equal only about 5-17% of the fees needed to first reach each tier, and combined give-backs (taker rebate up to 50% + maker rebate 15-25% + referral 10% of net) stay below 100% of fees, so wash or Sybil farming of this programme is negative EV even before enforcement. Omnibus-wallet integrations are ineligible, which penalises pooled copy-trading products. Geopolitics earns zero wV. Tier decays if volume drops.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Sum last-30-day taker fees across all own wallets by category, convert to wV with weight/feeRate, and read off the tier a consolidated account would hold and the dollar rebate at that tier.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Docs reserve the right to remove rebates and tier status for wash trading, self-matching or other inauthentic trading; third-party omnibus wallets not eligible.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Fee-regime routing: run taker strategies where feeSchedule.rate is zero
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Treat the per-market feeSchedule as a first-class signal and steer news, latency and arbitrage agents to zero-fee markets (all geopolitics; NFL game markets showed zero_fees on 2026-09-20) while steering maker agents to fee-enabled ones.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Polymarket's fee is set per market through a feeSchedule object (rate, exponent, takerOnly, rebateRate) and the docs instruct integrators to read it from market data since 2026-03-31. The published table makes geopolitics and world-events markets fee-free with no rebates, while other categories cost takers 1.0-1.75c per share at 50c. The live API can differ from the table: NFL moneylines on 2026-09-20 returned feeType zero_fees with rate 0 although the sports row says 0.05, and a BTC monthly strike market returned crypto_fees_v2 at 0.07 with 20% rebate. A routing layer tags every market with its live fee and rebate, computes strategy break-evens per market, and allocates taker-style agents (resolution sniping, news, cross-venue arb) to zero-fee inventory and maker-style agents to fee-enabled inventory where rebate and the taker wedge help them. Taker-rebate wV is zero in geopolitics, so tier-building flow should go elsewhere.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Attention to venue configuration that changes by changelog and sometimes silently; a 1-1.75c fee difference is larger than most systematic edges on this venue.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Geopolitics is already where informed flow concentrates (46% of US-linked wallet volume versus 36% platform-wide per Allium), which implies taker edge there is fee-free while makers there earn no rebate - a map most bots do not keep current.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Zero-fee promotions end without notice; fee-free markets attract the most informed counterparties, so maker agents should avoid them; category labels are assigned by Polymarket and can be surprising.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: Snapshot feeSchedule for all active markets daily for two weeks, diff against the docs table, and recompute last quarter's taker PnL per category net of what fees would have been under the live schedule.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Polymarket US Volume Incentive pools: get paid for taker flow you need anyway
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Route unavoidable spread-crossing flow (hedges, arb legs) into US contracts that carry a pro-rata taker-volume pool, e.g. $100,000 per NBA Playoffs moneyline market for in-game taker notional.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: For designated contracts the exchange posts a fixed pool split pro rata by eligible taker-side notional executed between 3c and 97c inclusive, with a $500 notional minimum and optional time-window Volume Multipliers. The docs' own example: $100,000 pool, $1M total eligible taker volume, your $100k share earns $10,000, i.e. 10% of notional, versus a maximum taker fee of 1.74c per contract at 50c. The programme went live 2026-05-21 with a $100,000 in-game pool on every NBA Playoffs moneyline market. On top, monthly taker volume of $250k/$1M/$10M earns 10/25/50% taker-fee rebates. A desk that already needs to cross the spread on the US book (hedging international, Kalshi or sportsbook exposure) times those executions into pool contracts and windows.
raw_discovery_candidates.edge_source: Subsidy per unit of taker volume can exceed fee plus half-spread when total eligible volume in a pool market is low; most retail takers do not know the pool exists or do not reach the $500 minimum.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Pool size is fixed ex ante while eligible volume is uncertain; in less-followed games the realised pool/volume ratio can be several percent of notional, turning marginal cross-venue arbs positive.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Pool/volume ratio collapses in marquee games; programme currently documented only for NBA Playoffs (NFL taker pools unverified); payout timing unspecified; trading with yourself or a colluding counterparty to manufacture volume is wash trading on a DCM; eligibility sits under Institutional programmes.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: From the public Time & Sales / trade stats for past pool markets compute realised taker notional inside 3c-97c and divide the pool by it; if the ratio exceeds about 2.5% (fee + half spread) on a meaningful share of games, the routing rule is worth building.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: US-only access. Volume generated without bona fide risk transfer (self-matching, pre-arranged trades) is wash trading under the Commodity Exchange Act; exchanges run self-match prevention and surveillance, and incentives can be withheld or reversed.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: US promotional-credit extraction by hedged conversion
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Convert non-withdrawable Polymarket US promo credits ($50 for a $10 deposit; deposit-and-trade campaigns capped at $1,000 per campaign / $2,000 total) into cash by hedging the credited position on another venue.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Polymarket US credits $50 once per participant after a $10 deposit and runs deposit-plus-trading campaigns (deposit tier bonus $10-$500; trading incentive requires trades priced 10c-90c; caps $1,000 per campaign and $2,000 across the programme). Credits can open positions and pay fees but cannot be withdrawn. The classic matched-betting conversion applies: spend the credit on one side of a liquid game and take the opposite side on the international book, Kalshi or a sportsbook, locking most of the credit's face value regardless of outcome. Yield is a one-off few hundred to about $2,500 per eligible person including the referral cap.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: Risk-free once hedged, but strictly bounded per real KYC'd person, so it is pocket money for a technical team, not a strategy to automate.
raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: Credits expire per campaign; hedge venue fees and spread consume 5-10%; incentives can be withheld, cancelled or reversed for suspected abuse.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: One team member who is a US resident runs the $50 credit through a hedged NFL moneyline and records net cash retained.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: One incentive per participant; opening additional accounts under other identities on a KYC'd, CFTC-regulated platform is fraud, not a ToS nuance. US residents only.

raw_discovery_candidates.name: Sign-up promo, bonus and referral extraction with hedged conversion (matched-betting transfer)
raw_discovery_candidates.one_line: Polymarket US and Kalshi now run sportsbook-style acquisition promos, such as deposit $10 and get $50. They are convertible to cash by hedging the other side on another venue, once per real person.
raw_discovery_candidates.mechanism: Claim the bonus. Polymarket US with code COVERS gives a $50 trading bonus on a $10 deposit. Kalshi codes are worth $25-60 after $25 of trades. Deploy the bonus on a near-coin-flip contract and hedge the opposite outcome at the cheapest venue. When the positions settle, the bonus has become withdrawable cash minus the cross-venue spread and fees. Referrals pay $25 per person up to $350 on Polymarket US. International Polymarket pays 10% of a referee's net fees and 5% indirect for 30 days, or until the referee reaches Platinum tier, and needs $10k of lifetime volume to qualify.
raw_discovery_candidates.why_might_beat_market: It is pure subsidy, but capped per KYC identity at tens to low hundreds of dollars. It only scales through multi-accounting, which is fraud under KYC. For this reader it is a rounding error, except as an affiliate or referral business line.
raw_discovery_candidates.adjacent_grounding: UK and US matched betting and sportsbook bonus hunting. Casino advantage play.

evidence.supports: A Polymarket US (QCX LLC) offer. The bonus must be used as trading collateral before withdrawal. It is 18+ with KYC and excludes Nevada. The referral pays $25 per person up to $350. This is an affiliate page, and I did not verify the terms against Polymarket US's own site.

evidence.title: Polymarket Referral Program
evidence.supports: 10% direct and 5% indirect of net fees for up to 30 days or until the referee reaches Platinum. Requires $10k lifetime volume. Self-referral, controlled accounts and inauthentic trading are prohibited, and clawback is at Polymarket's discretion.

evidence.title: Matched Betting Risks with Polymarket and Kalshi Props
evidence.supports: A hedge-breaking rule mismatch. If a player does not play, Polymarket grades the prop as No (a loss) and Kalshi settles at the last pre-game price, while sportsbooks void the bet. A 'matched' bet can lose on both sides. This shows the matched-betting community already uses prediction markets as a hedge leg.

raw_discovery_candidates.failure_modes: One use per identity. Bonus terms change. Rule mismatches break hedges. Accounts get closed for multi-accounting.
raw_discovery_candidates.cheap_validation: A single-identity trial. Compute the net conversion percentage after spreads.
raw_discovery_candidates.flags: Multi-accounting and self-referral breach ToS and, on KYC venues, amount to identity fraud. Polymarket US and the international site are separate entities with different eligibility. The international site restricts US persons.
